record.where: v3.15 — LIGHT HAS A BODY: the sources are fixed, not deleted, and the props join the hand

clauses.text: the law asserted at source level
the day-column measured empty and the night shaft measured present AND narrow
prop sprites sampled at their own paint
the fire caught changing shape between looks
every lamp, flame, bloom and cairn-light now draws a banded corona — a near-white emissive core, two solid hue-warmed bands at stepped alpha, and dither only as a one-texel stitch at each seam

figure.note: three alpha steps at source — the core and two bands — and on screen at least three hard levels outward from the core

clauses.text: Full-coverage checker is reserved for the one thing it is for — the unsolid: wraith bodies and the haze around the Kept keep it under its own name (ghostBody)
The station pillar is dead; in its place a beacon shaft that belongs to the night: gated to zero by day

figure.note: at high day the frame with the shaft allowed and the frame with it stopped differ by no pixel

clauses.text: at night a narrow column brightest at the flame
three vertical alpha bands with dithered hems

figure.note: the shaft's three alpha steps and three width steps read at source

clauses.text: Lit longhouse bays cast window-spill pools on the yard after dark
Fires are authored three-frame flames on logs — camps and every beacon cage

figure.note: three looks a sixth of a second apart catch three shapes, the look a second on the first again

clauses.text: authored sprites for the station mast (a timber lattice
metal and ceramic salvage piles, lumen blooms as two-frame crystal clusters

figure.note: the bloom's two frames differ; that it has no third is not read

clauses.text: ground crates (planked, banded by the icon law: gold for signed and lost cargo, lumen for cores)
cairns, the supply drop with its fallen chute, the Peddler's cart
the road paver with its warning stripe
and the Kept — who are now the rig itself in a ghost palette, standing where they fell, because they were walkers
Zero .arc( calls survive in the renderer

figure.note: no .arc(, quadraticCurveTo, createLinearGradient or ellipse in the renderer, one radial (the vignette)
